questions.question: Evaluate the effectiveness of on-the-job and off-the-job training methods
questions.solution_html:
• Effectiveness of On-the-Job Training
  • a) Learning by doing improves practical skills quickly. (8 marks)
  • b) Provides real work experience in actual job conditions.
  • c) Cost-effective as no separate training infrastructure is needed.
  • d) Immediate application of knowledge enhances retention.
  • e) Builds confidence and job familiarity.
  • f) Encourages interaction with supervisors and peers.
  • g) Limitation: May lead to errors or reduced productivity during training.
  • h) Limitation: Quality depends on the trainer’s ability.
  • Effectiveness of Off-the-Job Training
  • a) Provides a structured and systematic learning environment. (7 marks)
  • b) Allows focus without workplace distractions.
  • c) Useful for theoretical knowledge and conceptual understanding.
  • d) Exposure to new ideas, techniques, and innovations.
  • e) Safer learning environment—no risk to actual operations.
  • f) Limitation: Higher cost and requires special facilities.
  • g) Limitation: Less opportunity for immediate practical application.
questions.final_answer: Option Learning by doing improves practical skills quickly. (8 marks)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

  • a) Enhances employee skills and competencies- Improves job performance and efficiency. (15 marks)

  • objectives.

  • f) Facilitates adaptation to change- Helps employees cope with technological and organizational
  • changes.

  • h) Reduces employee turnover- Career development opportunities enhance retention.
  • i) Improves quality of work and services- Leads to better customer satisfaction.
  • j) Encourages continuous improvement culture- Builds a learning-oriented organization.
  • k) Enhances teamwork and collaboration- Develops communication and interpersonal skills.
  • l) Bridges skill gaps- Identifies and addresses deficiencies in workforce capabilities.
  • m) Supports succession planning- Ensures availability of skilled personnel for key roles.
  • n) Boosts organizational competitiveness- Skilled workforce provides a competitive advantage.
  • o) Ensures long-term growth and sustainability- Continuous learning supports organizational
  • development.
questions.final_answer: Option Enhances employee skills and competencies- Improves job performance and efficiency. (15 marks)

questions.question: Evaluate the effectiveness of on-the-job and off-the-job training methods
questions.solution_html:
• Effectiveness of On-the-Job Training
  • a) Learning by doing improves practical skills quickly. (8 marks)
  • b) Provides real work experience in actual job conditions.
  • c) Cost-effective as no separate training infrastructure is needed.
  • d) Immediate application of knowledge enhances retention.
  • e) Builds confidence and job familiarity.
  • f) Encourages interaction with supervisors and peers.
  • g) Limitation: May lead to errors or reduced productivity during training.
  • h) Limitation: Quality depends on the trainer’s ability.
  • Effectiveness of Off-the-Job Training
  • a) Provides a structured and systematic learning environment. (7 marks)
  • b) Allows focus without workplace distractions.
  • c) Useful for theoretical knowledge and conceptual understanding.
  • d) Exposure to new ideas, techniques, and innovations.
  • e) Safer learning environment—no risk to actual operations.
  • f) Limitation: Higher cost and requires special facilities.
  • g) Limitation: Less opportunity for immediate practical application.
questions.final_answer: Option Learning by doing improves practical skills quickly. (8 marks)
